title: Junior or Senior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read through the entire post before applying.  Thanks! ***



*** Company Description ***

Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication focused video content, primarily for aerospace, defense, and technical clients. Our work helps high stakes organizations explain complex ideas clearly, train teams effectively, and communicate with absolute precision. We operate with a military grade standard of excellence and are looking for a Junior/Senior Video Editor who is ready to grow within a high accountability environment.



While aerospace and defense are our core specialties, our projects vary widely. We need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to meet the specific goals of a diverse client base.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***

To succeed here, you must embody these three core values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without "floundering" or ghosting. You possess the self-discipline to manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Motivation and Dedication: You are dedicated to the mission and the company's growth. You don't just "do a job"; you look for ways to contribute to the overall success of the team.



Radical Integrity and Accountability: You own your mistakes immediately. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even if they are your own, because you understand that precision is non-negotiable.





*** Role Overview *** 

We are seeking a Full-Time Video Editor to join our team. This is a stable, 40-hour-per-week role. You will be responsible for executing the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director.



The ideal candidate can work independently on assigned tasks, manage massive amounts of data, and communicate proactively. We are looking for a professional who takes pride in technical accuracy and understanding how a project’s storytelling can achieve success for our clients.





*** Core Responsibilities ***

Video Editing: Execute the editing process for short- and long-form video content from start to finish, ensuring high-quality storytelling and pacing for all client projects.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable handling projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables. This includes managing RAW workflows and ensuring visual consistency.



Audio & Sound Design: Integrate music, perform basic audio cleanup/mixing, and ensure sound design aligns with the project’s goals.



Visual Polish: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as required by the project scope to create a polished, professional product.



Feedback & Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed-upon deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other freelancers or editors.





*** Required Qualifications ***

Professional Background: Demonstrated experience in video editing (freelance or agency). You should have a solid understanding of editing pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software Proficiency: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. While Resolve is our preferred NLE, we welcome expert Premiere editors who can deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong grasp of audio cleanup and mixing, as well as color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and color grading RED RAW footage. If you haven't handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner capable of managing complex, high-resolution media workflows.



Data & Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume of data.



Autonomy & Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You must be able to work independently without micromanagement and remain vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.





*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***

Motion Graphics: Experience with Fusion, After Effects, or equivalent tools for adding visual layers.



Graphic Design: Ability to create images, maps, diagrams, simple layouts, or visual explainers for complex concepts.



Industry Experience: Previous experience with educational, corporate, or technical content.



Collaboration Tools: Familiarity with structured feedback and client-facing revision workflows (specifically experience with 
).



Subject Matter Interest: A genuine interest in aerospace, defense, science, or complex technical subject matter.





*** Compensation ***

Starting at: $640 (~36,800 PHP) to $1,120 (~93,500 PHP) USD per month, based on 40 hours/week, subject to change. 

Starting at: $350 (~20,000 PHP) to $800 (~47,000 PHP) USD per month, based on 20 hours/week, subject to change. 

Starting Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour.  [*Conversions are approximate.]



Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $305 – $605 USD (~20,000 PHP – 47,000 PHP) monthly.

Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 – $1,600 USD (~36,800 – 93,500 PHP) monthly.



Rate Determination: Starting salary/rates are dependent upon experience and demonstrated skill.



A Note on AI and Judgment

At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. However, this role requires high level human judgment and Radical Integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt. If you use AI to draft your personal responses on the “How to Apply” section, you are failing the first test of this role: Honesty. We want to hear your real thoughts and see your real personality to ensure you will be a good fit on our team. If your application lacks a unique human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later; do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***

To be considered, you must follow these steps exactly. Attention to details is a requirement for this role.



-Change your subject line to: "Motivated Video Editor – [Your Name]".



-Must use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP)



-Provide a link to your best and most current video editing work (to include any additional skills you want to highlight, such as motion graphic heavy editing, etc.)  No portfolio = no consideration.



-In exactly two sentences, describe your experience  level with RED RAW footage? If none, how do you plan to manage the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media?  Use plain English; no AI-generated fluff.



-Attach or link to your CV/resume.  Must be in PDF format only.



-Want to really stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what about Aerospace & Defense interests you. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest!

Hours: 10 hours per week to start with opportunity to grow to 20 or more hours per week based on performance



Pay Rate: $4.00 USD per hour paid weekly via PayPal



About This Role



We are a professional services company based in Los Angeles, California run by Dr. Robert Jaffe, a licensed professional with over 40 years of experience working with businesses and professionals across the United States.



We are looking for a reliable, detail oriented, and warm natured Virtual Assistant to join our small team on a part time basis with the potential to grow into a full time long term position for the right person.



This is not a complicated technical role. Everything you need to do comes with a clear step by step written script and training. If you can follow instructions carefully, communicate professionally in English, and take pride in doing your work thoroughly and on time, you will do very well in this position.



What You Will Be Doing



Your primary job is to reach out to local businesses in the United States that do not yet have a website and introduce them to a professional website we have already built for them at no charge. You will do this using
, text message, and
 direct message following a script we provide.



When a business owner responds positively and claims their website, you will send them a warm welcome message, conduct a brief follow up phone or video call using a script we provide, collect some information from them to personalize their site, and introduce them to our additional services.



You will also keep a detailed tracking sheet updated in real time so our team always knows exactly where every client and every outreach attempt stands.



Specific daily tasks include the following.



Using our lead finding software to identify local businesses without websites. Building professional websites for those businesses using our AI website builder. Sending outreach messages via
, text, and
 following our provided scripts. Responding to interested business owners promptly and professionally. Conducting brief follow up calls using our provided call script. Completing a client intake form during each follow up call. Sending follow up information to interested clients. Keeping the tracking sheet updated after every action.



What We Are Looking For



You must have excellent written and spoken English. Your
s and messages will represent Dr. Jaffe's professional brand and must be warm, clear, and professional at all times.



You must be reliable and consistent. This role requires showing up and doing the work every scheduled day without being reminded.



You must be comfortable making phone or video calls to American business owners in English. A confident and friendly phone manner is essential.



You must be detail oriented and organized. Missing a follow up or forgetting to update the tracking sheet creates problems for our clients and our business.



You must have a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work and make calls.



You must be comfortable learning new software tools. Our platforms are simple and we provide training but you need to be willing to learn.



Experience with virtual assistance, customer service, outreach, or sales support is preferred but not required. We will train the right person from scratch.



What We Offer



A starting rate of $4.00 USD per hour paid weekly via PayPal every Friday.



A consistent and predictable part time schedule of 10 hours per week to start.



Clear written scripts and instructions for every task so you are never guessing what to do.



A supportive and respectful working relationship with Dr. Jaffe's team.



Real opportunity to grow your hours and your responsibilities as the business grows. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long term working relationship, not just fill a short term contract.



How To Apply



Please send the following three things in your application.



First, a brief introduction of yourself in your own words telling us who you are, what your work experience has been, and why this role appeals to you.



Second, a short recorded voice or video message of no more than two minutes introducing yourself as if you were calling an American business owner for the first time. You can record this on your phone and send the file or a link. This is the single most important part of your application because your phone manner is central to this role.



Third, your availability, meaning which days and hours you are available to work and what time zone you are in.



Applications without all three components will not be considered. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: STR Bookkeeper
description:
We run a short-term rental business with 9 furnished homes and are looking for a reliable bookkeeper to clean up our recent books and handle ongoing monthly bookkeeping.  This will start with a cleanup of the last 2–3 months, then transition into ongoing monthly work.  This is a long-term role for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with multiple properties.



Initial Work (Cleanup):

-Clean up and organize the last 2–3 months in QuickBooks Online

-We track bookings, revenue, cleaning fees, and owner payouts in Excel, and this will need to be matched and reconciled to QBO

-Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

-Fix and organize transaction categorization

-Match Airbnb/booking platform payouts to reservations

-Confirm owner payouts are correct for each property

-Flag any missing or duplicate transactions

-Prepare clean monthly Profit & Loss statements



Ongoing Monthly Work:

-Monthly bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

-Bank and credit card reconciliations

-Categorize income and expenses (Airbnb, Vrbo, direct bookings, utilities, maintenance, supplies, etc.)

-Track cleaning fees and vendor payments

-Record and verify owner payouts per property

-Provide monthly P&L reports (per property)

-Keep books fully up to date each month



What We’re Looking For:

-Strong QuickBooks Online experience

-Experience with Airbnb / short-term rentals

-Very detail-oriented and organized

-Clear communication and responsive

-Comfortable with multiple properties

-Proactive and able to spot issues, not just enter data

title: Marketing Specialist/ Digital Marketer/CMO/Marketing Manager
description:
We are the Graham Group, a top-producing real estate team with eXp Realty based in Birmingham, Alabama. Since 2012 we've built one of the most successful teams in our market — multiple-time eXp ICON Award winners, $40M+ in annual production, and trainers and coaches to 80+ agents nationwide.



We believe great real estate is about trust and systems: showing up like a professional from the first 
nt a consumer meets us, nurturing that relationship over time, and staying connected long after the sale. We're looking for a marketing leader who can build the engine that makes that happen at scale.





THE ROLE



This is not a "post on Instagram" job. You will own the entire marketing function for our team. You'll set the strategy, build the systems, generate leads, manage our content team, and tie every dollar we spend to a measurable result. You'll be the person who makes sure our brand looks elite, our pipeline stays full, and our database never goes cold.



If you're strategic and willing to roll up your sleeves, this is your seat.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Strategy & Brand

- Build and execute the team's overall marketing strategy and annual plan.

- Own our brand — voice, look, and consistency across every channel and touchpoint.

- Position the Graham Group as the trusted, go-to authority in our market.



Lead Generation

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns 
, Instagram, Google, YouTube).

- Drive a consistent flow of buyer and seller leads and track cost-per-lead and ROI.

- Develop landing pages, lead magnets, and conversion funnels.



Nurture & Trust Systems (core to who we are)

- Build automated and personal follow-up systems in our CRM that nurture leads from first contact to closing — and beyond.

- Create the "stay-in-touch" and post-close campaigns that turn past clients into repeat and referral business.

- Make every consumer feel like they're working with a true professional at every stage.



Content & Social

- Own the content calendar across YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, and
.

- Manage and direct the marketing editor and contractors to produce video, graphics, and listing content on schedule.

- Lead our YouTube and SEO strategy so we get found organically.



Listings & Agent Attraction

- Build a repeatable listing marketing system so every property gets a professional rollout.

- Support agent recruiting and attraction marketing for our growing team.



Analytics

- Track and report on every channel — leads, conversion, engagement, spend, and ROI.

- Use the data to double down on what works and cut what doesn't.





WHAT YOU BRING



- 3+ years of marketing experience with a track record of generating leads and measurable results (real estate or related industry strongly preferred).

- Both strategic thinking and hands-on execution — you can build the plan and do the work.

- Hands-on experience running paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads).

- Experience with a CRM and building
/automation nurture campaigns (Follow Up Boss, kvCore, or similar a plus).

- Strong grasp of social media, content, and SEO.

- Comfort reading data and reporting on ROI.

- Excellent written communication and a sharp eye for brand and design.

- Self-starter who thrives with systems and ownership.





NICE TO HAVE



- Direct real estate marketing experience.

- Experience managing a small team or contractors.

- Video, design, or copywriting skills.

- Familiarity with marketing automation and AI tools.





WHY WORK WITH US



- A proven, successful, growing team that genuinely values marketing.

- Real ownership of a function — your work directly drives the business.

- Performance-based upside tied to the leads and ROI you create.

- A leadership team that lives and breathes systems, training, and growth.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Submit your resume and a short note on a marketing campaign you ran that produced real, measurable results — what you did, and the numbers.

2. Include links to work samples or a portfolio.

3. Start your message with the word "SYSTEMS" so we know you read the full posting.



We're looking for a sharp, accountable marketing leader who wants to build something great with us. We can't wait to meet you.

title: Bookkeeper with QBO experience
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

We are looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to oversee the organization's financial record-keeping to ensure the business can make sound financial decisions. This position will be responsible for producing monthly financial reports, maintaining an adequate accounting record system, and managing a comprehensive set of controls, budgets, and forecasting to mitigate risks. The Bookkeeper will play a key role in enhancing the accuracy of the company’s reported financial results and ensuring those results comply with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and bookkeeping principles and procedures. This position will report directly to the Finance Manager.





This position is 100% remote.





ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, disciplined, accountable, transparent, aligned, and results-oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.

Wondering what it's like to work here? Come check this:


/watch?v=PIIv7sYj1Ns





SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Timely and accurate delivery of monthly financial reports, reconciliations, and compliance filings

- Organized and auditable accounting systems with well-maintained digital records and controls

- Budgets and forecasts are submitted on time with clear variance analysis and actionable insights

- All payables, debt obligations, and tax filings are completed without delays or errors

- Trusted financial insights that support business decisions and reflect a strong understanding of GAAP principles





OBJECTIVES

- Maintain an accurate and timely record of all financial transactions and issue timely and complete financial statements

- Perform account reconciliation to assert the accuracy of transactions and entries in the accounting system

- Develop a documented system of accounting policies and procedures

title: TikTok Shop Lead Operator — $2,000 base + 25% uncapped profit share + year-end bonus (US LLC handled)
description:
This is a reposted job with revised compensation base & updated job title. 

Compensation at a glance

$2,000/month base, paid weekly via Wise (guaranteed floor)

25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped

15% override on the net production of any helpers we hire under you

10% year-end bonus on your annual personal Net Profit, paid every January 31



Real comp examples: $3,250/mo at $5K NP · $5,750/mo at $15K NP · $9,500/mo at $30K NP (full math + worked example in the Compensation section below)



This pays 2–3x what every comparable TikTok Shop role on OnlineJobs.ph offers. Keep reading to see why we can pay this and what we expect in return.



Essentially: you are building an entire TikTok Shop affiliate company from the ground up, with full financial backing and US LLC infrastructure provided by us. You bring the operational skill. We bring the capital, legal structure, and US-side resources.



About this role:

This is not a typical VA role. This is a lead operator role for someone who wants to build a real TikTok Shop affiliate business and earn like a senior tea
mber with real upside, not a flat-rate VA.



We're a US-based holding company launching a TikTok Shop affiliate operation. We provide the infrastructure — US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US-resident device/IP setup, US shipping addresses, working capital, and TikTok Shop seller verification. You build and run the operation. Product research, account warming, scripts, content production, posting, optimization, scaling. When the time is right, you propose new hires and we approve, fund, and onboard them under our LLC — and you earn a cut of what they produce.



You're the operator on the ground. The owner is hands-on with strategy, sets all base pay, approves all hires and fires, and owns final say on direction. You drive execution day-to-day with real autonomy inside that framework.



If you've ever run a successful TikTok Shop account and thought "I should be doing this with a real company behind me instead of $2/hr for an agency" — this is that opportunity, with the US LLC infrastructure already solved.



What success looks like

Month 1: Two TikTok Shop accounts warmed and posting 5+ videos/day each, with first commission revenue landed

Month 3: Three accounts running, 10+ videos/day total, $3,000+/month in net profit, your share clearing $750/month on top of base

Month 6: Established daily playbook, $15,000+/month in net profit, your share at $3,750/month on top of base (total ~$5,750/month)

Month 12: Scaled operation with 1–2 helpers you've trained, $25,000+/month net profit possible, your share clearing $6,000+/month plus base plus year-end bonus



Day-to-day responsibilities

You own day-to-day execution. That includes:



Product research — daily Kalodata / Shoplus / FastMoss workflow, your own filter stack, daily shortlist of 10 candidates, scoring top-performing videos for replicability



Sample sourcing — submit free sample requests and refundable sample purchases via TikTok Shop Creator Center to our US shipping addresses



Content production — generate 5 script variants per winning product, brief US-based on-camera recorders with structured shot lists, edit raw clips in CapCut



UGC creator hiring — you can brief and hire US-based on-camera talent through 
 (you brief them, they record, you edit and post — they don't need to keep the product). Budget for this comes out of operating expenses, approved by us.



Account operations — stagger-post 5–15 videos/day across 2–3 TikTok accounts (each on its own isolated device/IP), tag every video's affiliate product from Showcase before publishing, manage comment moderation and account hygiene



Pre-followed account acquisition — purchasing TikTok Shop-eligible accounts (5,000+ followers) is a legitimate part of the playbook. You'll source candidate accounts and submit them for our approval before purchase.



Drop-off & hook analytics — pull swipe-away / retention curves from TikTok analytics on every video, identify exactly where viewers leave, and use that data to rebuild hooks that hold attention past the first 3 seconds



Performance management — track 24-hour and 72-hour performance per video in shared Google Sheets, flag winners and losers per decision rules you build (with our sign-off)



Team training (when we hire) — when we approve a new hire, you train them, oversee their daily output, and earn a percentage of their net production on top of your base and your own profit share



Must-haves

1+ year hands-on TikTok Shop affiliate experience (you've personally operated accounts, not just managed someone else's)



Working knowledge of Kalodata, Shoplus, or FastMoss — you can name the filter stack you'd use to find a trending product without us prompting



Hook analytics fluency — you regularly look at where viewers swipe away from your videos and use that data to rebuild hooks. You can explain a specific time you fixed a low-retention video by studying the drop-off curve.



Exceptional written English (your scripts go to US viewers; your briefs go to US recorders)



Proven ability to ship volume — 5+ videos/day, every workday, without quality drop



Data-driven mindset — you read GMV growth, commission rate, and affiliate count signals fast and act on them



2+ years remote work experience with verifiable OnlineJobs.ph or Upwork references



Proficient in Slack, ClickUp or Notion, Google Sheets, CapCut, ChatGPT



4+ hour overlap with US Mountain Time



Reliable computer, fast internet, backup power



Comfortable with daily WhatsApp check-ins (morning plan + end-of-day recap) and a weekly direction call



Operator mindset — you treat this like real work that compounds, not a 9-to-5



Nice-to-haves

Prior experience under a US-LLC-backed structure operating US-market TikTok Shop accounts

Experience editing UGC-style product review videos

Experience hiring and briefing UGC creators (HourlyUGC, Upwork, Billo, etc.)

Experience buying and warming pre-followed TikTok accounts safely

Hands-on with Claude Code for scripting and automation tasks

Familiarity with US residential proxy / remote-desktop tooling (AnyDesk, RustDesk, BrightData)

Experience running multiple isolated social accounts without crossing fingerprints

Prior experience training and overseeing junior tea
mbers



Resources we provide

US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US shipping addresses, TikTok Shop seller verification

Working capital for samples, account purchases, and initial creator briefs

Tools budget: Kalodata, Shoplus or FastMoss, ChatGPT Plus, Claude Code, CapCut Pro, any other tool you make a case for

US-based UGC talent budget via HourlyUGC and similar platforms

Daily strategy access to the owner via WhatsApp, weekly direction call



Compensation

Base salary: $2,000/month ($11.55/hr × 40 hrs/week), paid weekly via Wise — your guaranteed floor



Personal profit share: 25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped, for as long as you are with the company



Net Profit definition: Gross affiliate commission revenue minus all operating costs, including your $2,000/month base salary, contractor pay (UGC creators, helpers), software subscriptions (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.), sample purchases, account purchases, banking fees, and US LLC overhead. Your base is paid by the company as a normal expense — it does NOT come out of your 25% share.



Worked example (a $5,000 Net Profit month):



Gross affiliate commission revenue: $8,500

Less your base salary: ?$2,000

Less samples & account purchases: ?$500

Less software (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code): ?$300

Less UGC creator contractor pay: ?$500

Less banking and LLC overhead: ?$200

= Net Profit: $5,000



Your 25% share: $1,250

Your total monthly comp: $2,000 base + $1,250 share = $3,250

Comp at higher Net Profit tiers (base always paid separately on top):

At $5,000/month Net Profit: $2,000 base + $1,250 share = $3,250/month total



At $15,000/month Net Profit: $2,000 base + $3,750 share = $5,750/month total



At $30,000/month Net Profit: $2,000 base + $7,500 share = $9,500/month total



Team override (when we hire helpers under you): When the company hires a helper under your direction, the helper's net production is split three ways:



Helper: 25% of their own net production (same share structure as yours)



You (operator override): 15% of the helper's net production, paid monthly alongside your personal profit share



Company: the remaining 60%



The 15% override equals 20% of the company's 75% cut — a meaningful piece of every helper you train and retain. The better you train them and the longer they stay productive, the larger your monthly override grows. Worked example: if a helper generates $5,000/month in net production, helper earns $1,250, you earn an additional $750 override on top of your own profit share, company keeps $3,000.



Year-end bonus: At fiscal year-end (December 31), you receive a bonus equal to 10% of the personal net profit you generated for the company during that fiscal year, paid by January 31.



Example: if your personal accounts generated $120,000 in net profit across the calendar year, your year-end bonus = $12,000, on top of all monthly profit shares already paid



This is designed to reward staying through the full year — someone who's accrued meaningful YTD profit has a real reason to finish the year strong rather than walk in November



Bonus applies only if you're with the company on December 31 of that year



Performance floor: After the first 3 months (during which we are getting the process / pipeline up and running):

Your personal monthly net profit generation must clear your monthly base pay ($2,000). If you fall below base for 3 consecutive months OR any 4 months within a rolling 6-month window, the role is terminated unless we judge that exceptional extenuating circumstances apply (which we will weigh case by case).



Why this beats every comparable listing:

Typical TikTok Shop VA on OnlineJobs.ph: $800–1,500/month flat, no profit share, no bonus

Senior pod operator with commission: $1,500–2,000/month + 5% personal sales (~$1,750/month at our target revenue)

Most "profit share" listings: $2,000 base + 10?ove a high margin threshold (~$2,250/month at our target revenue)

This role at $15K/month personal net profit: $5,750/month + 15% override on any helpers you train (~$750/mo per $5K-producing helper) + year-end bonus accruing toward $12K+ — total annualized comp ceiling far above any flat-rate or pod role on this platform



Transparency: Net Profit is calculated from a Google Sheet you'll have read access to, updated daily. Every line item is visible. No black box.



How we work together

Daily WhatsApp check-ins. Each morning you send a short message with your plan for the day. Each evening you send a recap of what you completed. Takes 5 minutes total. This is non-negotiable.



Weekly direction call. One scheduled call per week (30–45 min) to discuss overall progress, priorities, and any decisions that need our sign-off.



Final decisions rest with us — all hiring, firing, base pay, account purchases, and revenue policy decisions default to the owner. You propose, recommend, build the case. We approve.



You have real autonomy inside that framework on day-to-day execution: content choices, hook iterations, posting cadence, niche pivots, product picks, contractor briefs.



Long-term mindset — the owner's other business has retained OnlineJobs.ph hires for 2+ years. We invest in operators who invest in us.



How to apply

Follow all application instructions below carefully.



In your application message, answer every question below, numbered, in order:



List every TikTok Shop affiliate account you've personally operated. Include handle and approximate monthly revenue at peak.



What product research tool do you use? Walk us through your exact filter stack — the specific filters, in order, that you'd apply right now to find a trending product worth promoting this week.



Describe one specific time you looked at a TikTok video's swipe-away curve, identified where viewers were dropping off, and rebuilt the hook to fix it. What did the original hook say, what did the data show, and what did you change it to?



Pick one TikTok Shop product you'd promote this week. Tell us (a) the product, (b) why you'd promote it (data-backed), and (c) the exact 3-second hook you'd open with.



Describe one independent operational decision you've made on a TikTok Shop account — what was the call, what was the data behind it, what was the outcome?



What's your current US Mountain Time overlap availability?



What tools are you currently paying for out of your own pocket?



Do you currently operate any personal TikTok Shop accounts? (Yes/No — full disclosure required if yes)



At the very end of your application, in the final line, type the word "Kalodata" so we know you read this entire post.



For applicants who do follow these instructions, we'll shortlist the strongest candidates for a paid 2-hour trial task ($16 paid via Wise), and then interview finalists directly with the owner.



We're hiring one person and we'd rather wait three weeks for the right one than three days for the wrong one.



If you've ever wanted to run a US-market TikTok Shop business with the LLC, banking, and infrastructure handled — this is your shot.

title: Creative Strategist / DTC Research VA — Long-Term Role with 2+ years experience
description:
About Us

We're a multi-brand DTC e-commerce company doing ~$200K/month. We run paid ads on Meta at scale and we're growing fast.

We're not an agency. We own our brands. That means when you write a winning ad, you see the spend scale, the ROAS climb, and the brand grow. Your work has real impact and you stay with us long-term.

We're hiring ONE Creative Strategist to work directly with the founder. This is a long-term role, not a project. If you want stability, growth, and to actually OWN the creative output of a real brand, keep reading.



What You'll Actually Do

You are the engine behind every ad we run. You research, you think, you write, and you brief our editors. The editors execute YOUR ideas. You will:



Write hooks, ad concepts, and short-form scripts (15s, 30s, 60s, and longer VSL formats)

Develop angles — new mechanisms, new avatars, new pain points, new positioning we haven't tested yet

Mine customer reviews, comments, and competitor ads to find winning insights and translate them into ads

Brief our video editors with clear, executable creative briefs (we'll teach you our brief format)

Analyze ad performance and tell us what to double down on, what to iterate, what to kill

Build creative variations from winners — take one winning ad and turn it into 10–20 meaningful variations

Research customer psychology using reviews from Amazon, Trustpilot, Reddit, and our own product pages

Manage the creative pipeline in Google Sheets / Notion (briefs, deadlines, asset tracking, performance)

Stay on top of competitor activity — what new ads are running, what offers are tested, what's scaling



The founder will work alongside you on strategy. But you own the creative output. If our ads suck, that's on you. If they win, that's on you too — and we pay accordingly.



Who This Is For

You are right for this role if:



You have at least 1 year of hands-on experience writing ads, hooks, and concepts for DTC or e-commerce brands. Not just "social media posts." Direct response paid ads.

You can show us ads you wrote that ran on Meta or TikTok with real spend behind them

You speak fluent written English and your writing has voice, rhythm, and persuasion — not robotic AI output

You're obsessed with customer psychology. You actually enjoy reading 100 reviews to find the one phrase that becomes the hook.

You're organized to a fault. Briefs go out on time, files named properly, sheets updated daily.

You can write FAST. A new hook in 10 minutes, not 2 hours. A full 30s script in 30 minutes.

You want to learn DTC marketing at a high level over 1–2 years and grow with one company.

You can work 30–40 hours/week consistently.



You are NOT right for this role if:



You're a graphic designer, video editor, or general VA looking to pivot. This is a writer + strategist role.

You write generic "benefit list" ads. We need angles, hooks, narratives — not bullet points.

You can't show real ads you wrote. Portfolio is mandatory.

You're using AI to write your application but couldn't defend your own answer live on a call.

You want to run 5 client gigs on the side. We need focus.





Compensation



Hourly: $5–8/hour depending on experience and portfolio strength

Hours: 30–40 hrs/week (full-time)

Schedule: Flexible. Some overlap with European hours required (5 hours/day minimum overlap).

Performance bonus: After 90 days, you earn a bonus every time one of your ads scales past a spend threshold at positive ROAS. Real money on top of base. We pay extra for winners.

Growth path: Strong performers move to $7–10/hour within 6 months and own a full brand inside the company within 12 months.



We pay on time. Every time. 



How to Apply (Read Carefully — Most Applicants Will Skip This)

We get a lot of AI-generated applications. We can spot them in 10 seconds and we delete them. Here's what we actually want:

1. Put the word "octopus" as the first word of your application. This tells us you read the post.

2. Pick ONE ad from Meta Ad Library (
.>
/ads/library) — any DTC brand, any niche. Then answer in your own words (NOT ChatGPT):



a) What is the hook in the first 3 seconds and why does it work?

b) Who is the target customer (avatar) and what is the main pain point or desire being triggered?

c) Write 3 alternate hooks you would test against this ad. Real hooks, written out as you would write them for a script.

d) What angle would you test next to improve performance (new avatar, new mechanism, new positioning)?



Keep it tight. 200–300 words total. We care about your THINKING and your WRITING, not the length.

3. Share your portfolio. Send 2–3 examples of ads, hooks, scripts, or concepts YOU wrote that ran for real brands. Drive link, Notion page, or PDF — whatever works. No portfolio = no interview.

4. Tell us:



Your hourly rate (within $5–8)

Your weekly availability (hours/week)

Your WhatsApp number

How many years you've specifically written ads, hooks, or scripts for paid social

Which brands or industries you've written for

One sentence: why this role specifically, not just "any job"





What Happens Next

If your application is strong, we send you ONE paid test brief — You write hooks, a script, and a short concept rationale. Pass that, and we book a 20-minute call.

After the call, we offer a 30-day paid trial at your hourly rate. After 30 days, we either commit long-term or part ways professionally.

We move fast. If we like you, you can be working within 1 week.



What We're NOT



Not an agency. You work with the founder directly.

Not a "job mill." We hire ONE person at a time and we keep them for years.

Not looking for graphic designers, video editors, or general VAs.



If this sounds like the right fit — apply today. We're reviewing applications this week and hiring fast.

title: AIRBNB VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — OPERATIONS & COLD CALLING
description:
**AIRBNB VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — OPERATIONS & COLD CALLING**

Haven Noire | Full-Time | 5+ Years STR Experience Required



---



**THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE. IF YOU DO NOT HAVE AIRBNB OR SHORT-TERM RENTAL EXPERIENCE, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.**



---



**QUICK FACTS**

- Type: Full-time, Remote

- Hours: 40 hrs/week | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CDT US TIME | Weekends required

- Pay: $4.00/hr base + uncapped commission per signed arbitrage deal

- Experience: Minimum 5 years Airbnb / short-term rental management

- Cold Calling: 80–150+ outbound calls/day required

- Start: Immediate



---



**ABOUT US**



Haven Noire is a newly formed US-based short-term rental company building a portfolio of Airbnb arbitrage and co-managed properties across multiple US markets. We are in active growth mode — you are joining early, and your performance directly shapes how fast we scale and how much you earn.



We need someone who can do two things well: run flawless STR operations AND get on the phone to bring new properties into our portfolio. If you are a closer who also knows Airbnb inside out, this role was written for you.



---



**THE ROLE**



This is a dual-function position. You will own both sides of our operation: securing new properties through outbound cold calling, and running day-to-day Airbnb operations once those properties are live.



---



**PART 1 — BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & COLD CALLING**



Because we are a new operation, securing properties is the first priority. You will be the first voice property owners hear from Haven Noire. Your phone performance directly drives your commission — there is no cap.



What you will do:

- 80–150+ outbound cold calls daily to US property owners and landlords

- Pitch Haven Noire's Airbnb arbitrage and co-management services

- Qualify leads and book appointments for deal closing

- Follow up with warm leads via call, SMS, and

- Maintain clean CRM notes after every call

- Research target markets and build prospect lists based on our criteria

- Draft and send arbitrage pitch letters and follow-up sequences



Cold calling requirements:

- Excellent spoken English — clear, natural flow, light or neutral accent. Non-negotiable.

- Previous cold calling experience: real estate, SaaS, insurance, or similar outbound roles

- Experience with dialers: Mojo, CallTools, RingCentral, or equivalent

- Experience with CRMs: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or equivalent

- Thick skin and self-motivation

- Reliable internet (25+ Mbps), noise-canceling headset, quiet workspace



---



**PART 2 — AIRBNB & STR OPERATIONS**



Once properties are signed, you manage our listings end-to-end: guests, cleaners, maintenance, platform health, and account protection.



Guest communication:

- Handle all guest messaging: pre-booking, during stay, post-checkout

- Respond within Airbnb SLA windows to protect Superhost status

- Manage booking requests, special needs, and issue resolution



Turnover & maintenance:

- Coordinate cleaners to ensure on-time turnovers between every booking

- Schedule and track maintenance requests with vendors and building staff

- Monitor property tech: Ring cameras, smart locks, noise monitors



Platform & account management:

- Handle Airbnb support tickets, case escalations, and claim negotiations

- Manage listing health: pricing, availability, photos, and descriptions

- Submit review removal requests when warranted, manage review responses

- Protect host accounts from flags, suspensions, or policy violations



Reporting:

- Maintain daily logs of guest status, cleaning schedules, and open issues

- Weekly reporting on occupancy, revenue, and operational flags



---



**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**



You must meet all of the following. No exceptions.



- Minimum 5 years of direct Airbnb or short-term rental management experience

- Proven portfolio — you must be able to show listings you have managed (URLs, screenshots, or references)

- Deep knowledge of Airbnb platform policies, terms of service, and case management

- Experience communicating with Airbnb support and resolving escalations

- Strong written English for guest-facing communication

- Excellent spoken English for cold calling — natural, clear, confident

- Prior outbound cold calling experience with measurable results

- Reliable internet 25+ Mbps, headset, quiet workspace



---



**BONUS QUALIFICATIONS (not required)**



- Experience as an Airbnb case manager or platform specialist

- Managed 20+ active listings simultaneously

- Cold calling experience in real estate, property management, or Airbnb arbitrage

- Mid-term rental strategy experience (30-day stays, travel nurses, corporate)

- Familiar with Hospitable, Guesty, PriceLabs, Turno, or similar tools



---



**HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY**



Applications missing any of the 3 items below will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



1. Voice memo (2–3 min) in English: introduce yourself, walk through your cold calling background, share your biggest phone win, and explain why commission-based work motivates you.

2. Written summary of your cold calling experience — industries, daily dial volume, conversion rates, appointments booked. Be specific with numbers.

3. Internet speed test screenshot showing 25+ Mbps.





Subject line: **"I dial, I close — [Your Name]"**



Write **"HAVEN NOIRE READY"** at the top of your message to confirm you read this posting in full.



Incomplete applications will not receive a response.

title: Google Ads Expert Needed — 5+ Years Experience Required
description:
Google Ads Expert Needed — 5+ Years Experience Required



We'll start you with a few accounts to test.  You'll start at 20 hours/week and then we'll increase as we see your results. 



We are looking for an experienced Google Ads expert to help manage, improve, and scale lead generation campaigns for service-based businesses.



This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who has been actively managing Google Ads campaigns for at least 5 years and has kept up with the latest Google Ads changes, including AI-driven campaign features, Performance Max, Demand Gen, AI Max for Search, conversion tracking, offline conversion imports (Not required but nice to have), audience strategy, bidding strategy, and campaign optimization.



The right person must understand how to generate quality leads, not just clicks, impressions, or cheap form submissions.



About the Role



You will help create, manage, monitor, and optimize Google Ads campaigns for local and service-based businesses.



The main goal is to generate qualified leads at a profitable cost.



You must be able to analyze campaign performance, identify wasted spend, improve conversion rates, lower cost per lead, and help improve lead quality.



You should be comfortable working with Search campaigns, Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube campaigns, remarketing, conversion tracking, landing page recommendations, negative keyword strategy, keyword research, audience signals, and bid strategy testing.



Responsibilities



? Build and optimize Google Search campaigns for lead generation

? Research keywords, search intent, competitors, and customer buying behavior

? Create strong campaign structures based on services, locations, and intent level

? Write and test ad copy that attracts qualified prospects

? Set up and manage negative keyword lists to reduce wasted spend

? Monitor search terms and identify new opportunities

? Optimize bidding strategies based on the campaign’s stage and available conversion data

? Improve cost per lead, conversion rate, and lead quality

? Set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking

? Work with Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads conversion actions, and call tracking when needed

? Help set up offline conversion tracking when possible (not required but nice to have)

? Analyze campaign data and explain what is working, what is not working, and what should be changed

? Provide clear weekly updates and recommendations

? Suggest landing page improvements to increase conversions

? Stay updated on Google Ads changes, including AI Max for Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, broad match changes, automation, bidding strategies, and reporting changes



Required Experience



? 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads management experience

? Proven experience managing lead generation campaigns

? Strong experience with Google Search campaigns

? Strong understanding of keyword match types, search intent, negative keywords, and campaign structure

? Experience with Performance Max campaigns

? Experience with YouTube or Demand Gen campaigns is a plus

? Experience with local service businesses, such as home services, HVAC, plumbing, restoration, legal, or similar industries is a strong plus

? Strong understanding of conversion tracking and attribution

? Experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4

? Ability to analyze data and explain findings clearly

? Ability to improve lead quality, not just lead volume

? Ability to work independently and make smart recommendations

? expeienced with meat ads is also a plus but not required. (do let us know if you have experience with meta)



You Must Understand



We do not only care about traffic.



We do not only care about impressions.



We do not only care about low-cost leads.



We care about profitable campaigns that generate real business opportunities.



A campaign that produces cheap but unqualified leads is not successful. We need someone who understands how to attract serious prospects, reduce wasted ad spend, and optimize campaigns based on actual business results.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



? Detail-oriented

? Honest about what the data shows

? Strategic, not just technical

? Strong at diagnosing campaign problems

? Able to explain recommendations clearly

? Comfortable testing different strategies

? Up to date with Google Ads changes

? Focused on ROI, lead quality, and booked opportunities

? Reliable with communication and deadlines



What We Are Not Looking For



Please do not apply if:



? You only have basic Google Ads experience

? You rely only on Google’s automated recommendations without thinking strategically

? You cannot explain why you make campaign changes

? You only focus on clicks, impressions, or CTR

? You do not understand conversion tracking

? You do not regularly review search terms and negative keywords

? You have not kept up with recent Google Ads updates

? You are not comfortable being measured by lead quality and campaign performance



To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1: How many years of hands-on Google Ads management experience do you have?



2: What types of businesses or industries have you managed Google Ads for?



3: What monthly ad budgets have you managed?



4: What is your process for improving lead quality in a Google Search campaign?



5: How do you d
 when to use exact match, phrase match, broad match, or AI-driven campaign features?



6: What is your experience with Performance Max?



7: What is your experience with AI Max for Search campaigns or newer Google AI-driven campaign features?



8: How do you track phone call leads, form submissions, and booked appointments?



9: Have you worked with offline conversion tracking or imported CRM data back into Google Ads?



10: Give an example of a campaign you improved. What was wrong, what did you change, and what were the results?



11: What tools do you use for reporting, tracking, keyword research, and optimization?



12: Are you available for part-time, full-time, or project-based work?



13: What is your hourly rate or monthly rate?

title: Executive/Personal Assistant – Marketing, Growth & Outreach Specialist
description:
Hey there,



I am an automation consultant and marketing agency owner expanding our business. I am looking for a powerhouse Executive Assistant (EA) who is a perfect mix of a brilliant B2B copywriter and a hungry outreach machine. 



Your primary focus will be building and launching our international B2B marketing engine in the English-speaking market from scratch (running LinkedIn outreach, content creation, and lead gen). 



Additionally, you will support our well-established German market by preparing marketing materials, asset templates, and market research behind the scenes. 



Please note: 100% of your work and communication will be strictly in English. I will handle any necessary localization or translation into German myself. You provide the strategic and creative English foundation; I adapt it where needed.



What you will do:

• LinkedIn Growth: Write, format, and schedule engaging English posts and carousels.

• Outbound Outreach: Actively research target markets, find relevant leads on LinkedIn, and handle initial outbound messaging (PR/Lead Gen).

• Content Prep & Scripting: Research industry trends and prepare scripts/bullet points for video content.

• Media Outreach: Research and reach out to magazines, blogs, and online publications for PR opportunities.

and more



What you must bring:

• Exceptional, flawless written English.

• High organizational skills – you love structure and stick to a daily plan.

• Proactive Problem-Solving: You do NOT need step-by-step handholding for every single task. You have the ability to think critically, use your own brain, google solutions when you get stuck, and bring proactive ideas to the table instead of just waiting to be told what to do.

• The ability to write high-converting copy AND the grit to do daily outreach.



Salary, Flexibility & Your Growth:

We believe in rewarding skill, not just hours. Therefore, we offer a flexible salary range based on your actual experience and copywriting quality:



• Entry/Junior Level: Starting at $600 - $800 USD / month

• Mid/Senior Level: Starting at $800 - $1,200 USD / month

• Plus: A 5% success share on every client brought in through your marketing/outreach efforts.



Why Work With Me (Culture & Freedom):

• Direct Partnership: You will work directly with me (the founder). No corporate politics, no slow decision-making. You will have a real voice in the business.

• High Autonomy, Zero Micromanagement: After an initial training and onboarding phase, I manage by results, not by hours. As long as the systems work, the content is consistent, and leads are coming in, you have maximum flexibility and freedom. 

• Continuous Learning & Variety: You will never get bored. You will help build an international B2B engine from scratch, test new marketing angles, and learn how cutting-edge automation scales a business.



The Long-Term Vision:

We are not looking for a temporary assistant; we want a true long-term growth partner. If you prove your ROI and help us successfully scale our international client acquisition, we are fully prepared to scale your compensation far beyond standard local rates—eventually matching Western-level income brackets as the business expands. If you deliver world-class results, you will get world-class pay.

---------------------------------------------------------------
. LinkedIn Outreach Experience: Please describe a SPECIFIC successful project or campaign where you did cold or warm outreach on LinkedIn. What was the offer, and what were the tangible results?



2. B2B Content Portfolio: Please provide 2-3 links or attachments of B2B content (LinkedIn posts, carousels, or articles) you personally created.



3. Big Success / EA Track Record: What is your biggest social media growth success (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn) OR a time you significantly helped a founder as a Personal Assistant?

description:
Hey there,



I am an automation consultant and agency owner looking for a brilliant Full-Stack Low-Code Developer & Automation Specialist to join me full-time. 



If you love building sleek user interfaces, setting up scalable databases, and connecting everything through powerful backend automation nodes, this role is built for you.



We have big plans for building internal SaaS products, handling high-level client projects, and launching automated "foot-in-the-door" lead generation tools. You will be the technical architect executing these ideas from scratch.



What you will do:

• App Development: Build and maintain responsive web and mobile SaaS applications using modern low-code platforms (or code them)

• Database Management: Connect and manage clean database structures using Firebase or Supabase.

• Advanced Automation: Build, test, and maintain complex backend workflows using n8n and Make.

• API Integrations: Connect various platforms, CRMs, and AI tools smoothly via custom API setups and webhooks.

• Custom Scripting: Write clean, basic scripts (JavaScript or Python) within automation nodes to handle complex data manipulation or custom server requests.

• Tech Research: Stay up-to-date with new cloud tools, AI developments, and deployment methods to constantly improve our ecosystem.



What you must bring:

• Proven track record of building and deploying functional applications (for example FlutterFlow also others are welcome).

• Deep mastery of automation tools (n8n or Make), REST APIs, JSON data, and webhooks.

• Solid understanding of relational/non-relational databases and backend logic.

• Basic coding skills (JavaScript or Python) to go beyond standard no-code limits when needed.

• Proactive Problem-Solving: You do NOT need step-by-step handholding. If an API documentation is messy or a deployment fails, you test, debug, google, and figure it out yourself.



Salary, Flexibility & Your Growth:

We reward technical versatility heavily. We offer a flexible salary range based on your actual coding, app-building, and automation skills:



• Mid-Level Builder: $900 - $1,200 USD / month

• Senior-Level Full-Stack Techie: $1,300 - $1,600 USD / month

• Plus: Performance bonuses as our automated lead generation assets and SaaS projects scale the company.



How we start (The Paid Trial):

We are looking for a sharp, Airbnb Property Manager to own our day-to-day portfolio operations. You will be the person who makes sure no listing gets suspended, no review attack goes unanswered, no maintenance issue festers, and no guest situation reaches the founder.



You will oversee a 50–100+ unit Airbnb arbitrage portfolio across multiple US markets, build and lead a team of operations VAs underneath you, handle every Airbnb platform issue that arises, manage dynamic pricing across the portfolio, and build the SOPs that turn this into a scalable machine. If you need to be told what to do when a listing gets suspended on a Friday night, this is not the right role for you. If you've handled that exact situation a hundred times before, this is exactly the right role.



What You'll Own Day-to-Day



-Oversee portfolio performance across all properties: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and listing health. Know the numbers cold every Monday.

-Handle every Airbnb platform issue end-to-end: listing suspensions, account warnings, review removal requests, Superhost status, account-level escalations. You write the appeals; you make the phone calls.

-Build and maintain relationships with Airbnb support and account managers. Get a named account manager assigned to our portfolio within your first 90 days.

-Manage dynamic pricing across the portfolio using PriceLabs or Wheelhouse. Audit base rates, minimum stays, and market conditions weekly.

-Triage maintenance issues and delegate to local vendors via your team. Make sure nothing sits in the queue longer than 24 hours.

-Hire, train, and manage a team of operations VAs underneath you. Run weekly 1:1s and a daily standup. Know each person's numbers.

-Build the full SOP library from the ground up: guest communication, escalation protocols, cleaner coordination, listing health audits, review response, maintenance workflows. We have basic systems. You will systematize the rest.

-Handle the rare guest or landlord escalation that requires senior judgment, including occasional phone calls with US-based clients and master-lease landlords.

-Report weekly to the founder: what's working, what's broken, what you're fixing this week.



You Are the Right Fit If...



-You have 5+ years of short-term rental / vacation rental operations experience, with at least 3 of those years in a senior or management role.

-You have personally managed 100+ properties in a single portfolio. You can tell us the exact unit count, the markets, and how many people reported to you.

-You have handled Airbnb listing suspensions before — and you have a track record of getting them reversed. You can walk us through a specific one start to finish.

-You are fluent with at least one major PMS: Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez. You know how to configure automated messages, build reports, and integrate channels.

-You have direct hands-on experience with revenue management tools — PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or Beyond. You don't just look at the dashboard; you adjust the strategy.

-You have managed at least 3 direct reports before. You can name them, recite their results, and tell us what happened to each one.

-You are a native or near-native English writer — clear, professional, direct. No fluff.

-You have a clear, neutral business-English speaking voice. You're comfortable on Zoom and on the phone with US founders, landlords, and Airbnb support.

-You operate with high autonomy. When the numbers slip, you have a hypothesis by lunch and a fix in motion by Friday.

-You have stable fiber internet (50 Mbps+), backup power or UPS, and a real workspace.

-You are available to work full-time during US Eastern Time hours.



Nice to Have



-Background at Vacasa, Evolve, AvantStay, Sextant Stays, Kasa, Sonder, Hostaway, Guesty, or a similar large STR operator.

Direct experience specifically with Airbnb arbitrage (managing rented units, not just owned ones).

-An existing relationship with an Airbnb account manager.

-Experience building SOP libraries from scratch.

-Experience hiring and managing offshore VAs.

-Familiarity with multi-market US STR operations.



What This Is NOT



-This is not a guest communications role. You will manage the people who do guest comms; you will not be the one answering messages all day.

-This is not a role for someone who has only managed their own properties. We need someone who has run a portfolio for an employer at meaningful scale.

-This is not a role for someone who needs hand-holding. The founder is hiring you specifically so he no longer has to think about operations.

-This is not part time. We do not consider candidates with other clients or side gigs.



Compensation



-$3,500 – $5,500 USD/month base salary, depending on experience and proven portfolio size. Paid monthly via Wise.

Performance bonus tied to portfolio KPIs (occupancy, listing health, review average, response time). = 15–25% of base annually.

-On track earnings of $4,600 to $6,875 USD a month

-Profit-share opportunity in the management division after 6–12 months of proven performance.

-Performance-based base raises available after 90 days.



How to Apply

Fill out this application: 
/to/ToAyj0Tb

Your job is to bring those ideas to life - editing, designing, scheduling, publishing, tracking performance, and keeping the entire production machine running smoothly.



This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented executor who can produce high-quality short-form content at volume, manage publishing workflows across multiple platforms, and actively use AI tools to increase speed and output. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it.



Responsibilities

- Produce 2 to 3 short-form videos and supporting graphics per day, including editing, trimming, captioning, and polishing content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Execute on creative briefs and direction provided by the Content Strategist, turning concepts into finished, platform-ready assets.

- Design on-brand visuals such as carousels, text graphics, thumbnails, and infographics that support the creator's style and messaging.

- Plan, schedule, and publish short-form content across all platforms while maintaining a balanced mix of educational, inspirational, and trend-based formats.

- Follow short-form trends including audio, hooks, captions, and editing styles, and flag relevant opportunities to the Content Strategist.

- Monitor performance metrics weekly and provide insights, recommendations, and data summaries based on watch time, retention, views, and engagement.

- Source and organize trending sounds, audio, and reference content to support the Content Strategist's ideation process.

- Coordinate collaboration posts and identify smart opportunities for creator crossovers and partnership content.

- Keep systems clean in Asana and Google Drive, ensuring clear task ownership, file naming, version control, and a predictable content runway.

- Use AI tools to streamline editing, captioning, clipping, and repurposing workflows to increase daily output and reduce turnaround time.

- Continuously improve and document production workflows to increase the efficiency and scalability of the content system.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience creating and publishing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts with proven results.

- Genuine interest in health, beauty, and aesthetics. You naturally follow this space, understand the visual standards, and have an eye for what looks premium.

- Editing and design expertise in short-form video editing using Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut, and strong design ability using Canva or Photoshop, including thumbnails, carousels, text graphics, and supporting visuals.

- Strong ability to take creative direction and execute it accurately and quickly with minimal revision cycles.

- Deep platform fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging formats, with a clear understanding of distribution mechanics and platform culture.

- Experience managing posting schedules and publishing workflows across multiple platforms, with strong attention to detail, file organization, and systems management.

- Ability to track and interpret performance metrics such as watch time, retention, views, and engagement, and surface insights to inform strategy.

- AI-forward operator who actively uses AI tools in editing and production workflows. Bonus for familiarity with tools such as Runway, VEO or Flow, ChatGPT, or Claude.

- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with the Content Strategist, editors, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively while operating in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

- Must submit a strong portfolio demonstrating editing, design, and creative execution across multiple short-form formats.

- Recognized for exceptional achievements such as attaining Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), performance awards, or demonstrating fast career progression into higher roles.



Results

- Social content consistently published within 24 to 48 hours of long-form production wrap.

- Sustained growth in high-quality engagement including shares, saves, retention, and audience sentiment.

- A cohesive, premium social presence that reinforces and amplifies the creator's broader ecosystem.

- Clean, organized production systems with predictable output and minimal missed deadlines.



Requirements for Effective Remote Work

- Reliable computer or laptop capable of video editing.

- High-speed internet connection plus backup.

- Conducive work environment.



Working Schedule

- Full-time remote position.



Compensation

- Salary will be based on skills, speed, portfolio output, and experience.



Benefits

- Competitive salary.

- Paid Time Off from day one, increasing to 10 days annually after six months with the company.

- Training and development opportunities.

- Opportunity to contribute to a rapidly expanding content team producing world-class creator content.

- Great potential for career advancement into leadership positions.

title: Finance & Office Manager
description:
About the Role

We are a fast-growing Australian-based accounting and financial services group seeking a capable Finance & Office Manager to manage internal finance and office operations across our group of businesses.



Our group operates across multiple divisions including bookkeeping, tax, finance broking, real estate, and global talent services. As the business continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of iinternal operational matters, ensuring that the firm runs efficiently behind the scenes.



This role will manage the firm’s internal finance, office administration, compliance coordination, and practice management processes, allowing the leadership team to focus on client service and business growth.



The ideal candidate will have strong accounting capability, excellent organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple internal functions simultaneously.



This position reports to the Operations Manager and works closely with internal teams to ensure smooth daily operations across the organisation. This role is expected to take ownership of all internal operational matters of the firm, including internal finance, office administration, compliance coordination, telecommunications management, marketing coordination, and practice management.



The Finance & Office Manager will work closely with the Operations Manager to ensure internal systems run efficiently and that the organisation operates in a structured and well-managed manner.



As the business continues to grow, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to build and manage internal processes and support functions, helping strengthen the operational backbone of the group.



Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Finance Management

Oversee internal financial administration across group entities, including:

• Bank reconciliations across group companies

• Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable management

• Internal billing administration and monitoring

• Expense tracking and cost monitoring

• Payroll administration support and superannuation coordination

• Supporting end-of-month financial administration including revenue tracking, gross profit monitoring and expense allocation

• Inter-company cross charges and internal allocations

• Supporting internal financial reporting preparation

• Supporting quarterly compliance preparation (BAS, IAS and related reporting)



2. Office Management

Manage internal office operations and administrative systems to ensure smooth day-to-day business operations.

Responsibilities include:

• Office administration and operational coordination

• Telecommunications management (phone systems, internet services and providers)

• Office facilities and vendor coordination

• Office systems administration and operational procedures

• Supporting internal office team coordination

• Monitoring administrative workflow efficiency

• Maintaining organised operational documentation and records



3. Marketing & Internal Coordination

Support internal marketing and communication coordination.

This includes:

• Coordinating marketing administration and campaign activities

• Supporting internal marketing initiatives

• Maintaining marketing materials and documentation

• Coordinating with external marketing partners when required

• Supporting internal communication initiatives



4. Compliance & Practice Management

Support internal governance and operational compliance across the firm.

Responsibilities include:

• Maintaining internal compliance calendars

• Coordinating annual administration including insurance renewals, workers compensation administration and internal compliance tracking

• Supporting practice management systems and processes

• Ensuring internal documentation and procedures remain organised and up to date



Reporting Structure

This role reports to the Operations Manager and works closely with internal teams to manage the firm’s internal finance and office operations.

The Finance & Office Manager will play an important role in ensuring all internal matters of the firm are properly managed and organised, supporting the overall efficiency of the business.



Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

• Minimum 2 years accounting or bookkeeping experience

• Strong understanding of bookkeeping and financial administration

• Excellent organisational and coordination skills

• Strong attention to detail and accountability

• Ability to manage multiple internal operational responsibilities

• Proficiency with accounting software and Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Demonstrated ability to take ownership of internal processes and improve operational systems will be highly regarded



Why Join Us

Our group is a growing multi-disciplinary business with strong 
ntum.



This role offers:

• Exposure to internal finance and operational management

• Opportunity to develop into a senior internal management role as the business expands

• Hands-on involvement across multiple businesses and industries

• Long-term career opportunities within an expanding organisation

description:
Job Description:

PAYJN is a global payment service provider. We are looking for a highly adaptable, detail-oriented, and disciplined Customer Support Specialist to join our core team on a Floating Shift basis.



This is NOT a voice call center job. It is a chat-based operational support role (mainly
). This is NOT a temporary or freelance gig; this is a long-term, stable role. As a floating staff member, you will act as the crucial flexible force for our team. The work requires you to be sensitive to numbers, quick to respond, and strictly follow our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).



Shift Details & Flexibility Requirements:



Nature of the Role: Full-Time Floating Shift (10 hours per shift).



Dynamic Schedule: Your schedule will vary based on team needs. Examples of a weekly roster (Manila Time):



Wednesday: Shift 2 (15:00 - 01:00)



Friday: Shift 1 (05:00 - 15:00)



Saturday: Shift 3 (19:00 - 05:00)



Coverage Duty: You may be required to cover a fixed shift for a consecutive week if a regular staff member is on vacation or leave. Roster adjustments will be communicated in advance.



Commitment: This requires extreme flexibility and the ability to adapt your sleep schedule. We only want candidates seeking long-term, stable employment who can handle dynamic hours.



Salary & Benefits:



Wage Calculation: Hourly rate based on a standard monthly formula: $450 / 26 days / 10 hours (Approx. $1.73/hour). You will be paid accurately for the actual hours and shifts you are assigned and work.



13th Month Pay: Pro-rated, applicable after 12 months of service.



Growth: Stable long-term role with potential to transition into a fixed shift based on performance and team expansion.



Preferred Experience & Traits:



High Adaptability: Proven ability to manage rotating shifts and switch sleep schedules without compromising performance.



Strong Attention to Detail: Ability to quickly spot discrepancies between customer screenshots, transaction numbers (UTR), and our system records.



Chat Support Experience: Previous experience in e-commerce, online payments, or fast-paced chat support 
/WhatsApp).



Strict Executor: You don’t need complex financial knowledge, but you must be able to follow clear instructions strictly without improvising.



Strict Requirements (The "No-Ghosting" Policy):



Absolute Availability: You must stay at your desk and respond within 1–3 minutes throughout your entire assigned shift, even during idle periods.



No Multitasking: You are strictly prohibited from holding other jobs, freelancing, or managing household chores during your shift.



Zero-Tolerance for "Ghosting": Disappearing during duty hours is grounds for immediate termination.



Technical Setup: Must own a reliable PC/Laptop (No mobile-only work), a stable internet connection (50 Mbps+ recommended), and keep TimeDoctor active for the entire shift.



How to Apply:

Please provide the following in your application:



[IMPORTANT] Start your application with the word "PAYJN" to be considered.



Self-Introduction: (Please include your age).



Flexibility Confirmation: Explicitly confirm that you accept rotating schedules (Day, Swing, Night) and can manage your rest effectively.



Technical Proof: Screenshot of your Internet Speed Test and PC Specifications.



Resume: Attach your latest CV.
